comment: Source of truth for platform → model mapping (v3, 2026-08-10). One tier per platform — no hardware tiers. Context window is derived from system RAM at runtime (8-16 GB → 16K, 16-32 GB → 32K, 32+ GB → 64K) and can be overridden by the plugin's Analysis depth preset (8/16/32K). KV cache: asymmetric iq4_nl-K / q4_0-V (1.0 B/elem; K feeds softmax with a ~3-bit precision floor per NexusQuant research, V compresses nearly free — TurboQuant TBQ3/TBQ4 types not in mainline llama.cpp, PR #21089 closed). Quant ceiling: Q4_K_M.

windows.criteria: Windows x64. GPU auto-probed (CUDA → Vulkan → CPU).

linux.criteria: Linux x64. GPU auto-probed (CUDA → Vulkan → CPU).

lotus-ai-4b-q4_k_m.comment: Lotus AI — fine-tuned Qwen3.5 4B legal agent (93% weighted legal benchmark vs 75% for 9B). Default for all local/downloadable tiers.

qwen3.5-9b-q4_k_m.comment: 9B deep-reasoning tier — server-side only (OpenRouter); downloadable for explicit opt-in.

bge-m3-int8.comment: BGE-M3 int8 ONNX — dense + sparse heads for local embeddings.

lotus-2-reasoning-q4_k_m.comment: Lotus 2 — native thinking trained in; single tool call + clean JSON under thinking; file-tool capable
